Subject: Holiday rota for December

Hi team,

Please find attached the draft holiday rota for December. I've tried to accommodate everyone's requests, but there are a few overlaps on the 23rd and 24th that we need to resolve. Can you check your allocated days and let me know by Friday if there are any issues? Also, remember that the office will be closed on the 25th and 26th, so those days don't count towards your allowance. Thanks, Sarah

Subject: Lease renewal reminder

Just a quick reminder that your apartment lease expires on 31st August. Please let us know if you intend to renew or if you'll be moving out.

Subject: Hackathon team assignments

Dear participants,

The team assignments for next week's hackathon are now finalised. You can view your team and assigned mentor in the shared spreadsheet. Each team will have 48 hours to build a prototype and present it to the judges. Please make sure to bring your own laptop and any necessary adapters. If you have any dietary restrictions, let us know by Monday so we can accommodate them. We're looking forward to seeing what you create! Best, The Hackathon Organising Team

Subject: Important updates to your lease agreement

Dear Tenant,

We are writing to inform you of some upcoming changes to your lease agreement. Starting from 1st October, the monthly rent will increase by 3% in line with the RPI. Additionally, we will be conducting annual fire safety inspections on 15th and 16th October between 9am and 5pm. Please ensure access to your apartment is available during these times. If you have any questions, feel free to contact the management office. Regards, Property Management

Subject: Hackathon schedule change

Due to unforeseen circumstances, the hackathon kickoff has been moved to 10am on Saturday. Please adjust your plans accordingly.

Subject: Your holiday rota preferences

Hi all,

We're now collecting preferences for the summer holiday rota. Please fill in the shared spreadsheet with your preferred weeks off by the end of next week. Note that we can only allow a maximum of two people off at the same time. If you have any special circumstances, please speak to me directly. Thanks, Mark

Subject: Apartment lease renewal – action required

Dear Resident,

Your lease is due to expire on 30th September. To renew, please sign and return the attached renewal form by 15th August. If you do not wish to renew, please let us know as soon as possible so we can advertise the property.

Please note that the rent for the new term will be £1,450 per month, an increase of £50. All other terms remain the same. If you have any questions, contact the letting agent.

Kind regards,

Jane Smith
Letting Agent

Subject: Hackathon judging criteria

Hello everyone,

Just a quick note to clarify the judging criteria for the upcoming hackathon. Projects will be evaluated on innovation, technical complexity, and presentation. Each team will have 5 minutes to demo and 3 minutes for Q&A. Judges will include industry experts from local tech companies. Good luck!

Subject: Holiday rota – final version

Dear colleagues,

Attached is the final holiday rota for the period January to December. Please review and note your allocated days. If you have any questions, please contact HR.

Best regards,
HR Team

Subject: Hackathon registration deadline extended

Good news! The registration deadline for the hackathon has been extended to 5pm on Friday. Don't miss out!
